stage1.ineligibility_reason: Practitioner presentation on electricity metering and monitoring-system (aM&T) planning for an ISO 50001 energy management system. Regression analysis, CuSum and energy 'drivers' (relevant variables) are mentioned only incidentally as generic data-analysis techniques; the paper does not present, propose, evaluate, or characterise any specific EnPI/EnB measurement model (no functional form, variable selection, or construction/estimation approach for a model). Falls under the tool/framework-without-model-content and incidental-mention ineligibility criteria.

paper_type.evidence_quote: an example of such a system is aM&T (automated Monitoring & Targeting)

stage1.notes: Borderline eligibility: metering/monitoring-focused practitioner paper that engages ISO 50001/50006 and names regression/CuSum/drivers generically without a characterised model. Not a review/synthesis, so borderline_review_synthesis_eligibility left false. Tier-1 call surfaced for human blind-first adjudication.
